name: ringFx
meaning: 1-slot ground ring pulse (Emitter_UpdateFade with g_defusableMineRingFxParams) spawned only in state 2 during the active half

name: phaseOffset
meaning: 0x3000 - ((CODEINIT<<12)/100 % 0x3000); phase = (g_gameTime + phaseOffset) % 0x3000. CODEINIT is in centiseconds

name: code
meaning: CODE: packed 2-bit DefuseSymbols, symbol i = (code >> (2i & 31)) & 3, first symbol in the low bits

name: seqIndex
meaning: current step of the playback/input sequence (reset by SetState(7/8))

name: codeLength
meaning: CODELENGTH (2-4 in shipped levels); compared unsigned

name: stepStart
meaning: g_gameTime when the current step began; beat = stepStart + 0x1000

name: finalSound
meaning: handle of sound 0x84 played in the final playback step's 2 s post-wait; stopped by SetState

name: dormant
meaning: 1 while phase < 0x1800 (first 1.5 s of each 3 s cycle): no proximity check and the DEFUSE prompt is offered; 0 in the active half

name: lightsShown
meaning: last beat-light count that played the 0x7e tick; 0xff at each step start
